SELECT 
    cd.cd_gender, 
    cd.cd_marital_status, 
    cd.cd_education_status, 
    COUNT(*) AS cnt1, 
    cd.cd_purchase_estimate, 
    COUNT(*) AS cnt2, 
    cd.cd_credit_rating, 
    COUNT(*) AS cnt3 
FROM 
    customer c 
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk 
    INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk 
WHERE 
    ca.ca_state IN ('IL','TX','ME') 
    AND c.c_customer_sk NOT IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk 
        FROM store_sales ss 
        INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk 
        WHERE 
            d.d_year = 2002 
            AND d.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3 
        UNION ALL 
        SELECT DISTINCT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk 
        FROM web_sales ws 
        INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk 
        WHERE 
            d.d_year = 2002 
            AND d.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3 
        UNION ALL 
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.cs_ship_customer_sk 
        FROM catalog_sales cs 
        INNER JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk 
        WHERE 
            d.d_year = 2002 
            AND d.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
    ) 
GROUP BY 
    cd.cd_gender, 
    cd.cd_marital_status, 
    cd.cd_education_status, 
    cd.cd_purchase_estimate, 
    cd.cd_credit_rating 
ORDER BY 
    cd.cd_gender, 
    cd.cd_marital_status, 
    cd.cd_education_status, 
    cd.cd_purchase_estimate, 
    cd.cd_credit_rating 
LIMIT 100
